newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tankan confirms economic recovery continuing--MOF.
newsitem.headline: Tankan confirms economic recovery continuing--MOF.

text.p: Better-than-expected results from the Bank of Japan's "tankan" survey of business sentiment show that Japan's economic recovery is continuing to become firmer, Vice Finance Minister Tadashi Ogawa told reporters on Thursday.

Asked what he thought about the tankan results released on Wednesday, Ogawa said: "It showed once again that the ground of economic activity is getting firmer, as I have been saying all along in the past year or so."
The tankan showed a sharp improvement in business sentiment among major manufacturers.
